subtasks.title: Pin branch in _pool_acquire_critical_section
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: system_context.md §6 + synthesis.md §2.3(c). _pool_acquire_critical_section = lib/pool.sh L2203–L2248, running INSIDE the flock subshell (pool_acquire_locked L2280–L2292; `flock 9` L2289 on $POOL_STATE_DIR/acquire.lock). Current flow: passthrough guard L2211 → stale-reap/REUSE-ORPHAN scan L2213–L2233 → CHOOSE-N via pool_find_free_lane L2234 → CLAIM L2240–L2244: pool_lease_write "$N" "$ephemeral_dir" 0 "abpool-$N" "$POOL_OWNER_PID" "$POOL_OWNER_COMM" "${POOL_OWNER_STARTTIME:-0}" "${POOL_OWNER_CWD:-}" 0 0 "false" (provisional port=0). pool_lane_is_stale (L1178–L1211) tri-state: rc 0 = stale, rc 1 = live, rc 2 = no lease. _pool_release_lane_internals (L2050–L2095): idempotent, non-fatal, kills the chrome process group, removes lease + ephemeral dir. pool_die inside the flock subshell is safe (exits subshell → flock auto-released → rc propagates; documented at L2259–L2260). Format validation of N already happened pre-flock in P4.M1.T2.S1 (§2.20).
2. INPUT: POOL_LANE_PIN ("" = existing auto path must stay byte-identical) from P4.M1.T2.S1; the four POOL_OWNER_* globals from pool_owner_resolve (caller OR ancestor mode — the pin branch is mode-agnostic).
3. LOGIC: At the top of the critical section, when POOL_LANE_PIN is non-empty set N="$POOL_LANE_PIN" and SKIP the reap-all/adopt/choose-N flow entirely (a pin never consults pool_find_free_lane — it has no bound and would pick a different N). Handle lane N under the flock: (1) pool_lane_is_stale rc 2 / no lease AND no $POOL_EPHEMERAL_ROOT/$N dir (FREE) → CLAIM N with the exact existing claim call (provisional port=0, session "abpool-$N"). (2) rc 0 (STALE) → _pool_release_lane_internals "$N" then CLAIM N — NO adoption (deterministic assignment prefers a clean lane; deliberately unlike the auto path's REUSE-ORPHAN which binds foreign live orphans). (3) rc 1 (LIVE) + lease owner is ME (owner.pid/comm/starttime match the current POOL_OWNER_* triple) → idempotent reuse: printf '%s\n' "$N"; return 0 — NO lease rewrite. (4) rc 1 (LIVE) + FOREIGN owner → print a diagnostic to stderr naming lane N and the live owner pid ("pinned lane is held by a live owner — a pinned lane is never a takeover") then exit non-zero (§2.15 row: fail fast; no block-with-timeout, no force). (5) I already hold a LIVE lease on a DIFFERENT lane → same hard-error treatment (preserves the ≤1-lane-per-owner invariant; scan leases for a live one owned by POOL_OWNER_PID on lane ≠ N — the existing scan loop body L2213–L2233 is the template). Boot is NOT touched: a pinned provisional lane boots exactly like an auto one (wrapper reads port==0 → pool_boot_lane L3665–L3674); ownership/reaping rules apply in both modes (pinned lanes are still lazily reaped when the owner dies). Verify: bash -n + shellcheck clean; unpinned path byte-identical.
4. OUTPUT: pool_acquire_locked (still single-line echo of the chosen lane number, rc 0) returns N == POOL_LANE_PIN on claim/reuse and exits non-zero with a stderr diagnostic on conflicts — consumed by P4.M1.T4.S2 (wrapper contract) and tested by P4.M2.T1.S4.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] configuration.md pin subsection + troubleshooting rows ride in P4.M1.T4.S3 (same Task) so the documented error texts mirror the exact strings implemented here — record the exact diagnostic/die strings you emit for (4) and (5) in the subtask output for that mirror.

subtasks.title: Pin matrix selftest (free/stale/live-mine/live-foreign/other-lane)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:

The matrix lives in pool_acquire_locked → _pool_acquire_critical_section (lib L2203–L2248) — directly callable, Chrome-free (claims write provisional port=0 leases; boot never runs). Stale-lane construction: acquire as owner A, kill+wait A → pool_lane_is_stale rc 0. Live-foreign: A alive holds lane M; attempt pin as owner B. Live-mine: same owner pins the lane it holds. Die-assert idiom: subshell + `|| rc=$?` + assert_eq + grep stderr for the diagnostic text (recorded strings from P4.M1.T4.S1/S2 output). LOGIC: New selftest (suggest selftest_lane_pin_matrix), one scenario at a time with own sim owners, capture→reap→assert ordering: (1) FREE: ABPOOL_LANE=7 with lane 7 unleased → pool_acquire_locked echoes 7; assert_lane_exists 7; lease port == 0 (provisional) via the existing lease-field read (rc-guarded `|| x="").
